issues.location: proof that addition by one gives the successor ordinal
issues.finding: The displayed codomain equates alpha disjoint-sum one with a disjoint sum of already tagged products. By the preceding definition, those tagged products must instead be united.
issues.proposed_resolution: Replace the second disjoint-sum operator between the two tagged products with set union; retain the original alpha disjoint-sum one and the explicit isomorphism.

issues.location: zero case of the ordinal-addition recursion proof
issues.finding: The proof simplifies zero times singleton to singleton zero. It is the empty set, so the displayed equality as written is false.
issues.proposed_resolution: Replace the spurious singleton zero in that one displayed step with the empty set; keep the rest of the derivation.

translation_treatment: The Javanese target uses union between the tagged product sets in the successor isomorphism and the empty set in the zero-addition calculation. The frozen source remains unchanged.
